title: "ADHD/Depression commorbidity analysis"

# Control for comorbidities between Depression and ADHD
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# clean slate to be sure
rm(list = ls())

# check for pacman package and install if not found
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
  pacman::p_load(readr,psych,polycor,corrplot,dplyr, tidyverse, here, circlize, BiocManager, ComplexHeatmap, gplots, gridExtra, gt, kableExtra, ggcorrplot, shape, patchwork, tidyr, ggwordcloud)

rest_probes <- read.csv("~/Git/BodyWanderingCCA/data/rest_probes.csv", row.names = 1)

alldata <- read.csv("~/Git/BodyWanderingCCA/data/BodyWanderingData_ids.csv", row.names = 1)

# change name as requested by reviewer
colnames(rest_probes)[colnames(rest_probes) == "Ruminate"] <- "Repetitive"
colnames(alldata)[colnames(alldata) == "Ruminate"] <- "Repetitive"

```


```{r}
# merge mental health data with mind/body-wandering probes
cols = c("asrs.combined.sum", "mdi")
corrdata <- cbind(rest_probes, alldata[ ,cols]) 
colnames(corrdata) <- c(colnames(rest_probes), "ADHD (ASRS)", "Depression (MDI)")

# partial correlation (depress controlling ADHD & vice versa)
library(ppcor)
library(ggplot2)

items <- colnames(rest_probes)
symptoms <- c("ADHD (ASRS)", "Depression (MDI)")

# matrices: items (rows) × symptoms (cols)
rmat <- pmat <- matrix(
  NA, nrow = length(items), ncol = length(symptoms),
  dimnames = list(items, symptoms)
)

for (i in seq_along(items)) {

  # Item–ADHD (control Depression)
  df1 <- corrdata[, c(items[i], "ADHD (ASRS)", "Depression (MDI)")]
  df1 <- df1[complete.cases(df1), ]
  if (nrow(df1) > 5) {
    out1 <- pcor.test(df1[[1]], df1[[2]], df1[[3]], method = "spearman")
    rmat[i, "ADHD (ASRS)"] <- out1$estimate
    pmat[i, "ADHD (ASRS)"] <- out1$p.value
  }

  # Item–Depression (control ADHD)
  df2 <- corrdata[, c(items[i], "Depression (MDI)", "ADHD (ASRS)")]
  df2 <- df2[complete.cases(df2), ]
  if (nrow(df2) > 5) {
    out2 <- pcor.test(df2[[1]], df2[[2]], df2[[3]], method = "spearman")
    rmat[i, "Depression (MDI)"] <- out2$estimate
    pmat[i, "Depression (MDI)"] <- out2$p.value
  }
}

df_plot <- reshape2::melt(rmat, varnames = c("Item", "Symptom"), value.name = "r")
df_plot$p <- reshape2::melt(pmat)$value

ggplot(df_plot, aes(Symptom, Item, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#4a6fe3", mid = "white", high = "#d33f6a",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(p < .05, sprintf("%.2f", r), "")),
    size = 3
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Item–Symptom Partial Spearman Correlations",
    subtitle = "ADHD controlled for Depression; Depression controlled for ADHD",
    x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "rs"
  )

# Save the plot
ggsave("~/Git/BodyWanderingCCA/figures/Indiv_Figures/ControlAnalyses/ADHDdepressComorbidityControl/PartialCorr_ADHDdepressItems.png", width = 7.5, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = 'white')


```
